title: Victoria TX Food Not Bombs August 2026 food share
summary: Current public event listing identifies Victoria TX Food Not Bombs as host of an August 16, 2026 food share and states ungifted donations go to the Free Store.

data.notes: Listing names Victoria TX Food Not Bombs as host/publisher for the August 16, 2026 food share in Victoria, Texas. It says items donated but not gifted at the food share will be put in the Free Store.
